children: Kyle Doops screens altcoins by relative strength rather than drawdown, and only HYPE, TRX and Monero passed BeInCrypto’s test across the 20 largest non-stablecoin assets. According to BeInCrypto, Bitcoin was not among them, while Chainlink, Cardano and Polkadot were far below their records. Doops cited Hyperliquid as his strongest example, and said altcoins are mainly a short-term vehicle to rotate capital back into Bitcoin.

title: Only 3 Altcoins Pass Kyle Doops’ Relative Strength Test
